parameterization.J: real symmetric upper triangle, general not rank-one or PSD
parameterization.U: ffsim real skew exponential; faithful real_schur_column_gauge_v1

objective_definition.tail: Original-frame prefix LD2; actual nonidentity rotated-Z/ZZ coefficients; identities extracted as deterministic phases
objective_definition.loss_scale: max(initial raw tensor loss,1e-14 Ha^2), shared and frozen
objective_definition.mass_scale: initial smooth tail mass, shared and frozen
objective_definition.baseline: New paired normalized tensor-only CDF; not replay of old H4 fit
objective_definition.ffsim_tol_is: Initializer truncation tolerance; no scipy tol override and no new truncation with saved initializer

call_definitions.original_input_load: Load saved original h/g/c once; do not decode old optional scientific arrays
call_definitions.saved_initial_load: Load only J/U from shared saved CDF8 export once
call_definitions.corrected_codec: One shared faithful Schur/gauge roundtrip with structural and tensor guards
call_definitions.tensor_assessment: Before/after codec and two final exports, each grouped tensor Frobenius/max/objective
call_definitions.objective_setup: Shared initial f/gradient and smooth mass normalization
call_definitions.fit_input_load: One prepared snapshot load per fit process
call_definitions.optimized_fitter: One ffsim optimizer invocation per role; internal nfev/njev recorded, no extra fits
call_definitions.fit_initial_diagnostic: Value/gradient, raw tensor objective, exact and smooth mass before each optimizer
call_definitions.fit_final_diagnostic: Same diagnostics and x/gradient after each optimizer
call_definitions.snapshots_load: One initial snapshot group and one final pair
call_definitions.physical_sector: Original h/g/c physical sector operator once
call_definitions.sector_assessment: Original/codec/paired-final DF sector norm plus existing guard
call_definitions.representation_assessment: Independent general-K sum versus raw-CAR at each of four snapshots
call_definitions.initial_gate: Codec sector fidelity and original/codec DF budget before either optimizer
call_definitions.comparison: Optimizer/DF qualification and registered exact-tail-mass reduction only

execution_order: prepare shared saved initial J/U, codec, tensor, normalization
physical sector36 and initial raw-CAR/general-K, codec-fidelity and DF-budget gates
two independent fit processes, each one existing ffsim L-BFGS-B invocation
final tensor/sector/general-K for both arms even finite optimizer failure or budget NOT_MET
registered comparison, evidence and mandatory STOP

decision.initial_correctness_or_budget_failure: STOP before either optimizer; partial evidence retained
decision.final_DF_budget: Each arm independently evaluates norm+guard; no fallback to initial
decision.proxy_pass: Both success and both budget PASS, exact lambda proposed <= 0.99*baseline, baseline>0
decision.NOT_MET_is_not: Physical impossibility or PR resource NO-GO

future_policy_proposal.law: ideal finite-RTE IID, fresh independent trajectory per occurrence
future_policy_proposal.Gaussian: Common validated precision and legal fusion for both arms; PR provider integration still to qualify

resources.parallel_work: Two independent fit subprocesses, actual task count and current resource_plan
resources.dominant: Existing JAX tensor loss/gradient and two fits, no new dense full-Fock operators
resources.coordination: Check affinity/quota/available RAM/pressure before launch; coordinate own JAX/BLAS threads to avoid oversubscription

stop: SOURCE/input/package/codec/nonfinite/representation correctness mismatch: dependent work STOP, safely collect begun work and retain partial evidence
Initial sector budget NOT_MET: no fits
Finite optimizer unsuccessful: diagnose returned state; no retry
Final budget or proxy NOT_MET: report both roles, do not adopt initial or alter gamma/rank
Mandatory STOP after Stage A; no automatic Stage B/C or alternate objective
forbidden: more than one fit per role
future_permission: Separate explicit user chat instruction for this fixed Stage A SOURCE/conditions; no proof-of-approval artifacts or grants
